slug: 2025-08-12 Zambia sees civil registration as bedrock of inclusive digital transformation
note: The article reports the Minister of Home Affairs and Internal Security's three aims for the CRVS system ahead of Africa CRVS Day, 10 August 2025: integration with health, education, identity and social protection systems; modernisation through digitisation to widen coverage; and decentralisation towards remote communities. All are stated as aims; no system is named or described and no office count, record method or dated rollout is given. Also stated: a 50 percent birth registration target by the end of 2026.
